poses.caption: Press down through the supports with straight arms and shoulders lowered. Hold your hips and both straight legs clear of the floor, with legs horizontal.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Premium original ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1402 L SIT. ONE STATIC HOLD exactly one whole person supported on TWO LOW STABLE PARALLETTES, bodyweight no weights. Side-front three-quarter full-body view facing RIGHT. Hands firmly grasp horizontal parallel handles beside hips, fingers wrap handles thumbs opposed, wrists neutral. Both elbows fully straight, shoulders actively depressed down away ears. Pelvis suspended above ground BETWEEN supports, no seat. Upright torso and BOTH legs straight together extending HORIZONTALLY forward to RIGHT at hip height, knees extended toes forward, complete torso-leg silhouette LETTER L. Both heels/feet AIRBORNE clear floor. Two separate realistic stable gray parallettes grounded below hand contact; no bar through body. Head neutral aligned torso. Primary ABS diffuse RED educational tint on intact black tank LOWER FRONT abdomen only. Keep fabric smooth and opaque with broad natural cloth folds; NO visible abdominal fibers/rectus segmentation through clothes. Exposed limbs detailed fine grayscale muscle contours realistic hands proportions. Fully opaque BLACK tank wraps front sides back and BLACK mid-thigh shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH with seams broad real folds no cutaway/transparency. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background subtle floor contact shadows generous12percent margins entire head fingers both supports and feet within SQUARE. Reference original project rendering STYLE ONLY ignore pushup pose chest red. Equal male/female quality. No text labels arrows numbers extra panels.
jobs.inspectionNote: Two L-sit candidates, one static pose per variant, two built-in calls.
